request.prompt:
Use the attached exact project reference as the ONE dedicated KURTZ boss design. Broad blackened engraved full plate armor, huge spiked steel shoulder pauldrons, decorated closed horn-point helmet with dark visor slit, red neck cloth and skull clasp, LONG TORN SCARLET CAPE, wide long steel GREATSWORD in anatomical RIGHT hand, empty LEFT hand, no shield. Massive plated boots and gauntlets. Keep these same costume proportions and materials on every single sprite. Dark fantasy painted high-quality isometric game sprites, crisp full bodies, fixed camera looking down 25 degrees. NO TEXT, NO labels, NO gridlines, NO shadows, NO visual effects. TRUE transparent background. No clipped blade/cape/helmet/boots. Strict equal-cell grid with at least 12px transparent inset around each complete character in every cell. Never cross cells. All source pixels belong to isolated independent full-body sprites. Canvas portrait 1024x1536.
Exactly 24 separate full-body sprites in a 4 COLUMNS x6 ROWS grid. Columns are FOUR DIFFERENT cameras/facings: column1 EAST head/chest/toes point SCREEN RIGHT, pure right side; column2 SOUTHEAST points LOWER RIGHT front-right three-quarter; column3 SOUTH faces viewer, chest/visor front visible; column4 SOUTHWEST points LOWER LEFT front-left three-quarter. Each column has the same view in every row. Exactly SIX rows of poses in temporal order. Row1 RUN contact: anatomical RIGHT boot forward PLANTED and LEFT behind raised. Row2 RUN compression: RIGHT leg supporting and LEFT leg driving forward. Row3 RUN suspension: LEFT knee forward, RIGHT leg trailing. Row4 OPPOSITE RUN contact: anatomical LEFT boot forward PLANTED and RIGHT behind raised. Row5 compression: LEFT leg supporting and RIGHT leg driving forward. Row6 suspension: RIGHT knee forward, LEFT leg trailing. Row1 and Row4 MUST have opposite support feet, with visibly exchanged leg positions. The sword stays held close along the right flank so there is generous cell space. Cape trails opposite travel, changes curved folds with stride, heavy torso has restrained bounce. Do not repeat the same leg-forward stance in both halves. Same fixed camera and anatomy within each column. Individual cells have equal scale and a stable foot baseline for each phase; anatomy must move, not merely translate.
